title: Engine base: Grillo's wayfinder with source recording, contradiction check, map-done and structure-section rules
summary: Ships Grillo own wayfinder skill (grillo-wayfinder) with the record-answer reference, a shared fixture checker and 83 new tests; approved by two fresh reviews and merged on a green local Windows gate (CI blocked by billing).
friction: Merged on red CI at the owner explicit instruction (merge anyway): GitHub Actions refused every job because of an account billing block, so the gate was a local Windows run only and nothing was tested on Mac; preflight does not check that CI can start a job, so this surfaced only after a full dev and review cycle.

deferred.what: The code that copies skills into a member's project copies every file, so grillo-wayfinder's test file and fixtures land in the project's .claude/skills/grillo-wayfinder/; a vitest run in that project picks up the test and fails on its missing ../catalogue import.
deferred.why: The copy code belongs to the agent runtime story, outside this issue's seam.

deferred.area: resources/skills/grillo-wayfinder/ and the store claim rule
deferred.what: The frontier includes tickets already assigned to the member and the claim treats 'already assigned to the member' as won, so two grilling agents on one laptop (one login) both claim the same first frontier ticket and post duplicate answers; issue #121 (open another grilling agent during a live session) requires that two grilling agents never work the same ticket.
deferred.why: Needs a per-agent tie-break that the store's claim rule (mandated by this issue's criteria) lacks; a store and PRD design choice.
